'''2008 Worlds Day 2 James Booker LS Massassi Base Operations''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[James Booker]] at [[2008 World Championship]] (Day 2). Sheet title What'd You Expect Me To Play, Something Else? Inventory side wrongly DS.


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[James Booker]]
* '''Event:''' [[2008 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS16]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Massassi Base Operations / One In A Million|Massassi Base Operations]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
